newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds prices mixed in thin market.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds prices mixed in thin market.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices were mixed on Thursday in a thin market.
Brokers said many buyers were put off by higher soymeal prices following the fall in Chicago on Wednesday.
"A lot of buyers were disappointed by the higher prices but after the early gains in Chicago it seems that the sellers got it right," said a broker.
High protein soymeal ex the Seaforth mill was one to two stg up while stores were one stg higher.
Rapemeal from the mills at Erith, Liverpool and Hull were all around one stg down while resellers was unchanged.
Corn gluten feed pellets ex-store Liverpool and Portbury was unchanged.
Sunflower pellets ex-mill Erith was unchanged while imported meal on the east coast was one stg down to unchanged.
Brokers reported only one trade when A.D.M. rape meal fetched 124 stg a tonne for spot.
"The week did not start that well and it's getting worst as it goes on," said one broker.
